text:
mika: kicking off staged apply for tenant-42 network + iam changes. planning a canary to us-west-2a only, 15min quiet window. will pin provider to hash to avoid provider drift. pls ack if you have live work in that tenant.

deploybot: plan started — see logs: https://deploy.logs/repo/infra/tenant-42/plan/6178901122 :white_check_mark:

deploybot: plan summary: 7 resources to change, 2 resources to recreate (aws_ebs_volume, aws_iam_role_policy). risk: iam role policy string replacement.

sanjay: ack. I'll standby for the IAM review. can we add a preflight check for service-account bindings?

mika: yes — included a check script. snippet: ```bash
./scripts/check-tenant-bindings.sh tenant-42 || exit 1
```

anya: FYI rotating bastion SSH key later today — won't affect this. tagging as nonblocking.

jules: suggested rollback criteria: if p50 latency spikes > 30% or 5xx rate > 1% for 2 consecutive minutes in canary region, abort and run restore. Also if terraform plan shows drift on >3 resources.

mika: agreed. setting canary SLOs and alert thresholds. opsbot, please wire the canary monitors to this thread.

opsbot: monitor created: tenant-42-canary (p50 latency, 5xx rate). webhooks -> #incidents and this thread.

deploybot: preflight apply command: ```bash
TF_VAR_tenant=tenant-42 TF_WORKSPACE=tenant-42 \
terraform apply -auto-approve -target=module.network -lock-timeout=10m -var-file=tenant-42.tfvars
```

mika: performing canary apply in us-west-2a. provider pinned to hash: provider.aws v4.2.1+sha256:abc123def. do NOT merge provider bumps into this branch during window.

sanjay: noted. I'll watch IAM audit logs for unintended policy expansions.

deploybot: canary apply started at 6178901138. plan output attached.

deploybot: canary apply completed at 6178901155 — no errors. 2 resources recreated.

mika: validating post-apply checks: binding script OK, connectivity smoke ok, ebs volume attached.

jules: pulling metrics — p50 steady, 5xx at 0.08% — within thresholds.

mika: rolling to full region in 3 waves (us-west-2b, then us-west-2c). stagger 10m between waves. everyone keep eyes open.

anya: small note — make sure the KMS key alias is present in all AZs before wave 2. I'll push a tiny tf change if not.

mika: hold wave 2 if KMS alias missing. manual approval required in thread.

deploybot: wave 1 started at 6178901170.

deploybot: wave 1 complete at 6178901180. no errors.

mika: stopping between waves to validate. if any regression, rollback plan: run terraform apply -replace=aws_iam_role_policy.this -var-file=tenant-42.rollback.tfvars and notify security.

sanjay: copy. ready to revert immediately if audit flags appear.

mika: final note — adding release note to changelog: "tenant-42: network optimizations + IAM policy tightenings (canary: us-west-2a)". tagging release manager. :memo:

jules: thumbs up. I'll archive plan outputs and attach to the release ticket.

mika: thanks team. keeping this thread open for post-rollout observations for 30m.
